entries.review: Preserve both the complete equipment name and the named synthesized ability disappearing. Native conditional newline keeps the whole message on one line when both fields fit; otherwise the item and complete predicate remain on separate lines.

abilities.review: Independent T2 comparison preserves direction count, target category, damage/consumption factor, protection or drawback. Half/Double Hunger denote consumption rate.
